text:
The silence of the long conflict was shattered not by the sound of battle, but by the sudden, overwhelming roar of celebration that swept through the village. Strangers became family in an instant, embracing tightly as tears of profound relief streamed down faces that had known only fear and uncertainty for so long. The weight of the war finally lifted, replaced by the radiant hope that the sons, daughters, husbands, and wives who had been taken would soon return to their arms.

The longest river in the world is the Nile.
